persona: Mid-level structural CAE analyst in automotive durability
resumeText:
Arjun Nair | Chennai | arjun.nair@example.com

EXPERIENCE
CAE Engineer, Coromandel Engineering Simulations, Chennai (2020 - present)
- Built shell and hex meshes in ANSA for chassis brackets and engine mounts.
- Ran linear static analysis of suspension parts in ANSYS Mechanical.
- Set up non-linear contact analysis in Abaqus for bolted joints and rubber bushes.
- Predicted fatigue life of welded brackets with nCode DesignLife from road load data.
- Correlated strain results with test data from the durability lab and updated material cards.
- Presented simulation results and design change proposals to the vehicle design team.

EDUCATION
ME Engineering Design, PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore, 2020

SKILLS
HyperMesh, Nastran, Python
